name: 皮肤切换器-Skin Changer
author: Gurio
description: 切换角色、卡牌、怪物、先古场景和商人皮肤；多人游戏可按玩家同步角色皮肤，并在明确允许后为当前房间临时缓存安全静态素材。界面支持 15 种语言，无需重启。 Switch character, card, monster, Ancient, and merchant skins; multiplayer can sync character skins per player and, after explicit consent, temporarily cache safe static assets for the current room. 15-language interface, no restart required.
